target_text: Suspected Japanese strong point at Tasimboko, in support of Edson's raid
source_locator: R2227: Part VI, ch. 5; R2224: Tasimboko (PL4915)
notes: USMC Operations vol. I, Part VI, ch. 5: at about 0630 on 8 September 1942 planes of MAG-23 bombed and strafed the suspected strong point at Tasimboko. The source names the group, not a squadron, so the mission is entered on MAG-23. Confidence 0.7. Base claim for MAG-23 on 8 September is in force (interval claim). If US-MARRAID-001 is not the raider battalion id used in the dataset, the supported_unit_ids value must be the existing 1st Raider id; it is US-MARRAID-001.
